name: YouthCity Paid City Department Internship (Salt Lake City)
org: Salt Lake City Youth and Family Division
what_you_do: Teens work for 8 weeks in a Salt Lake City department. They go to workforce trainings, build a resume and plan a career path. Performance expectations match entry-level jobs.
who_can_apply: Teens ages 16 to 18 who are work eligible.
pay_detail: Paid. The wage is not stated on the program page.
duration: 8 weeks. The teen page lists 8 week internship dates of June 8 to July 30, 2026.
deadline_text: Summer 2026 applications are closed. 2027 dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: The city teen page says this program needs an online application. For next steps, call Erica Andino at (385) 309-7439. She is the Senior Community Programs Manager.
notes: This is the paid internship. High school students get priority. The two unpaid Child Development internships on the same page (grades 7 to 12) are a different program. The school-year afterschool program on the page said it was no longer taking applications.
